mapper.insert: INSERT INTO source_file(path, file_key, generation, byte_offset, anchor_hash, observed_size, modified_at, scanned_at) VALUES(#{path}, #{fileKey}, #{generation}, #{byteOffset}, #{anchorHash}, #{observedSize}, #{modifiedAt}, #{scannedAt})

INSERT INTO raw_jsonl_record(source_id, generation, byte_offset, end_offset, content_hash, raw_bytes, raw_text, parse_status, event_type, event_time, ingested_at) VALUES(#{sourceId}, #{generation}, #{byteOffset}, #{endOffset}, #{contentHash}, #{rawBytes}, #{rawText}, #{parseStatus}, #{eventType}, #{eventTime}, #{ingestedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM source_file ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw_jsonl_record
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO raw_hook_event(delivery_id, observed_at, received_at, forwarder_version, raw_json, parse_status, error_code) VALUES(#{deliveryId}, #{observedAt}, #{receivedAt}, #{forwarderVersion}, #{rawJson}, #{parseStatus}, #{errorCode})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM raw_hook_event WHERE delivery_id = #{deliveryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO normalization_job(source_kind, source_id, status, attempts, available_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{sourceKind}, #{sourceId}, 'PENDING', 0, #{now}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM normalization_job WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw_hook_event
mapper.update: UPDATE normalization_job SET status='RUNNING', attempts=attempts+1, updated_at=#{now}, error_code=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE normalization_job SET status='COMPLETED', updated_at=#{now}, error_code=NULL WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE normalization_job SET status='FAILED', updated_at=#{now}, error_code=#{errorCode} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM raw_hook_event WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hook_session(session_id, transcript_path, started_at, ended_at, state, last_observed_at, version) VALUES(#{sessionId}, #{transcriptPath}, CASE WHEN #{eventName}='SessionStart' THEN #{observedAt} END, CASE WHEN #{eventName}='SessionEnd' THEN #{observedAt} END, CASE WHEN #{eventName}='SessionEnd' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN #{eventName}='SessionStart' THEN 'RUNNING' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END, #{observedAt}, 1) ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET transcript_path=COALESCE(hook_session.transcript_path, excluded.transcript_path), started_at=COALESCE(hook_session.started_at, excluded.started_at), ended_at=COALESCE(hook_session.ended_at, excluded.ended_at), state=CASE WHEN hook_session.state IN ('COMPLETED','INTERRUPTED') THEN hook_session.state WHEN excluded.state='COMPLETED' THEN excluded.state WHEN hook_session.state='RUNNING' THEN hook_session.state ELSE excluded.state END, last_observed_at=MAX(hook_session.last_observed_at, excluded.last_observed_at), version=hook_session.version+1

INSERT INTO hook_turn(session_id, turn_id, started_at, ended_at, state, version) VALUES(#{sessionId}, #{turnId}, CASE WHEN #{eventName}='UserPromptSubmit' THEN #{observedAt} END, CASE WHEN #{eventName} IN ('Stop','Interrupt') THEN #{observedAt} END, CASE WHEN #{eventName}='Stop' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN #{eventName}='Interrupt' THEN 'INTERRUPTED' WHEN #{eventName}='UserPromptSubmit' THEN 'RUNNING' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END, 1) ON CONFLICT(session_id, turn_id) DO UPDATE SET started_at=COALESCE(hook_turn.started_at, excluded.started_at), ended_at=COALESCE(hook_turn.ended_at, excluded.ended_at), state=CASE WHEN hook_turn.state IN ('COMPLETED','INTERRUPTED') THEN hook_turn.state WHEN excluded.state IN ('COMPLETED','INTERRUPTED') THEN excluded.state WHEN hook_turn.state='RUNNING' THEN hook_turn.state ELSE excluded.state END, version=hook_turn.version+1

INSERT INTO hook_tool_call(session_id, turn_id, tool_use_id, tool_name, pre_observed_at, post_observed_at, state, estimated_duration_ms, duration_valid, version) VALUES(#{sessionId}, #{turnId}, #{toolUseId}, #{toolName}, CASE WHEN #{eventName}='PreToolUse' THEN #{observedAt} END, CASE WHEN #{eventName}='PostToolUse' THEN #{observedAt} END, CASE WHEN #{eventName}='PreToolUse' THEN 'RUNNING' ELSE #{terminalState} END, NULL, 0, 1) ON CONFLICT(session_id, turn_id, tool_use_id) DO UPDATE SET tool_name=COALESCE(hook_tool_call.tool_name, excluded.tool_name), pre_observed_at=COALESCE(hook_tool_call.pre_observed_at, excluded.pre_observed_at), post_observed_at=COALESCE(hook_tool_call.post_observed_at, excluded.post_observed_at), state=CASE WHEN hook_tool_call.state IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED','INTERRUPTED') THEN hook_tool_call.state WHEN excluded.state IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED','INTERRUPTED') THEN excluded.state WHEN hook_tool_call.state='RUNNING' THEN hook_tool_call.state ELSE excluded.state END, estimated_duration_ms=CASE WHEN COALESCE(hook_tool_call.post_observed_at, excluded.post_observed_at) >= COALESCE(hook_tool_call.pre_observed_at, excluded.pre_observed_at) THEN COALESCE(hook_tool_call.post_observed_at, excluded.post_observed_at)-COALESCE(hook_tool_call.pre_observed_at, excluded.pre_observed_at) END, duration_valid=CASE WHEN COALESCE(hook_tool_call.pre_observed_at, excluded.pre_observed_at) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(hook_tool_call.post_observed_at, excluded.post_observed_at) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(hook_tool_call.post_observed_at, excluded.post_observed_at) >= COALESCE(hook_tool_call.pre_observed_at, excluded.pre_observed_at) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, version=hook_tool_call.version+1
mapper.update: UPDATE raw_hook_event SET parse_status=#{status}, error_code=#{errorCode} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM hook_session WHERE session_id=#{sessionId}
SELECT * FROM hook_turn WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND turn_id=#{turnId}
SELECT * FROM hook_tool_call WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND turn_id=#{turnId} AND tool_use_id=#{toolUseId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hook_turn t
WHERE lower(t.session_id) LIKE '%' || lower(#{query}) || '%' OR lower(t.turn_id) LIKE '%' || lower(#{query}) || '%'

SELECT t.*, s.transcript_path, s.state session_state,b.path_status transcript_path_status,b.session_check_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hook_tool_call x WHERE x.turn_id=t.turn_id) tool_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.hook_node_id) FROM performance_alignment a JOIN hook_tool_call x ON x.tool_use_id=a.hook_node_id WHERE x.turn_id=t.turn_id AND a.level='EXACT') otel_tool_count FROM hook_turn t JOIN hook_session s ON s.session_id=t.session_id LEFT JOIN transcript_binding b ON b.session_id=t.session_id WHERE t.turn_id=#{turnId}
SELECT * FROM hook_tool_call WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} ORDER BY COALESCE(pre_observed_at, post_observed_at), tool_use_id
SELECT id, delivery_id, observed_at, raw_json, parse_status FROM raw_hook_event WHERE json_extract(raw_json, '$.turn_id')=#{turnId} ORDER BY observed_at, id
mapper.insert: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO raw_otel_object(batch_id, object_index, signal_type, trace_id, span_id, turn_id, call_id, object_kind, duration_ms, event_time, received_at, raw_json, parse_status) VALUES(#{batchId}, #{objectIndex}, #{signalType}, #{traceId}, #{spanId}, #{turnId}, #{callId}, #{objectKind}, #{durationMs}, #{eventTime}, #{receivedAt}, #{rawJson}, #{parseStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw_otel_object WHERE signal_type=#{signalType}
SELECT s.session_id, s.transcript_path FROM hook_session s LEFT JOIN transcript_binding b ON b.session_id=s.session_id WHERE s.transcript_path IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transcript_binding(session_id, configured_path, canonical_path, path_status, source_file_id, session_meta_record_id, jsonl_session_id, session_check_status, adapter_version, checked_at) VALUES(#{sessionId},#{configuredPath},#{canonicalPath},#{pathStatus},#{sourceFileId},#{sessionMetaRecordId}, #{jsonlSessionId},#{sessionCheckStatus},#{adapterVersion},#{checkedAt}) ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET configured_path=excluded.configured_path, canonical_path=excluded.canonical_path, path_status=excluded.path_status, source_file_id=excluded.source_file_id, session_meta_record_id=excluded.session_meta_record_id, jsonl_session_id=excluded.jsonl_session_id, session_check_status=excluded.session_check_status, adapter_version=excluded.adapter_version, checked_at=excluded.checked_at
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM transcript_binding ORDER BY checked_at DESC
SELECT * FROM raw_jsonl_record WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} ORDER BY generation, byte_offset

mapper.insert: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO performance_alignment(hook_node_type,hook_node_id,otel_object_id,level,evidence_json,algorithm_version,time_delta_ms) SELECT 'TOOL',h.tool_use_id,o.id,'EXACT','{"field":"tool_use_id/call_id"}','codex-2026-09', ABS(COALESCE(h.pre_observed_at,h.post_observed_at)-COALESCE(o.event_time,o.received_at)) FROM hook_tool_call h JOIN raw_otel_object o ON o.call_id=h.tool_use_id
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT o.* FROM raw_otel_object o LEFT JOIN performance_alignment a ON a.otel_object_id=o.id LEFT JOIN hook_tool_call h ON a.hook_node_type='TOOL' AND a.hook_node_id=h.tool_use_id WHERE o.turn_id=#{turnId} OR h.turn_id=#{turnId} ORDER BY COALESCE(o.event_time,o.received_at)
SELECT a.* FROM performance_alignment a JOIN hook_tool_call h ON a.hook_node_type='TOOL' AND a.hook_node_id=h.tool_use_id WHERE h.turn_id=#{turnId} ORDER BY a.id

SELECT s.*,r.raw_text FROM jsonl_supplement s JOIN raw_jsonl_record r ON r.id=s.raw_record_id WHERE (s.hook_node_type='TURN' AND s.hook_node_id=#{turnId}) OR s.call_id IN (SELECT tool_use_id FROM hook_tool_call WHERE turn_id=#{turnId}) ORDER BY r.event_time,r.id
SELECT * FROM unknown_mapping WHERE fingerprint_id=#{id} AND status='VALID' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT r.* FROM raw_jsonl_record r JOIN unknown_record u ON u.raw_record_id=r.id WHERE u.fingerprint_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.id
